description: Validates the transformed adapter response against the adapter's known response_schema from the catalog after post_transform_hook has run. Non-blocking — flags schema mismatches as warnings rather than failing the pipeline, allowing partial data to flow downstream. Ensures that any API changes (fields added, removed, or type-changed by the external provider) are detected and surfaced in the pipeline audit log. Useful for catching breaking changes in bureau APIs, GST API, and KYC adapters that update their response formats without notice.
use_cases: Detecting when a bureau API drops a field from its response
Flagging type mismatches in adapter response for downstream data quality
Surfacing breaking API schema changes in credit bureau or GST adapters
Non-blocking data quality check on every API response
Audit logging of schema warnings for regulatory review
when_to_use: Attach to all adapters in production to catch upstream API schema changes. Non-blocking so it will not interrupt pipeline execution.
trigger_condition: After post_transform_hook; validates the transformed response against the catalog's response_schema

input_parameters.description: Response schema from the adapter catalog JSON

output.on_failure: schema_warnings array emitted with mismatch descriptions; pipeline continues
